name: cavemio-command-output
title: Command output
description: A command the agent runs: the log streams in, folds away on success, and stays open on failure.

cavemio.usage:
import { CommandOutput } from "@/components/command-output";

<CommandOutput command="pnpm test" status="running" lines={lines} startedAt={startedAt} onStop={stop} />
cavemio.accessibility:
- The log is a role="log" region you can focus and scroll with the keyboard; only status changes are announced, never the ticking timer.
- It keeps following new lines only while you are at the bottom of the log.
- Colour is never the only signal: failing lines are also announced by the "Failed with exit code" status.
- Installs Number roll and Text morph. With reduced motion, the fold, rolls and the scroll to the error are instant.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: lines
props.description: – · The log so far. ANSI colour codes are stripped; error-looking lines are marked unless you set level.

props.name: startedAt / endedAt
props.description: – · A live timer while running, then the duration (1.8s, 2m 4s).

props.name: open / onOpenChange
props.description: – · Control the log yourself; by default it is open while running or failed.

features.title: The command and a live timer
features.description: It shows “$ pnpm test”, the seconds rolling while it runs, and a Stop button.

features.title: The log follows the newest line
features.description: It keeps following only while you are at the bottom, so you can scroll up and read.

features.title: It tidies away on success
features.description: The log folds away and leaves one line with the command and its duration, such as 1.8s.

features.title: It stays open on failure
features.description: The exit code shows in red, and the first failing line is marked and scrolled into view.

features.title: Cleaned-up output
features.description: ANSI colour codes are stripped, and lines that look like errors are marked unless you set the level.

features.title: Stopped means stopped
features.description: A cancelled command reads “stopped” and its log folds away.

states.title: running
states.description: "$ pnpm test", a spinner, "running" with seconds that roll once a second, and Stop. Lines fade in and the log follows them unless you scroll up.

states.title: success
states.description: The spinner blurs into a check that draws itself (380ms), "running" morphs to "done" and "1s" settles to "1.8s"; Stop folds away as the chevron opens in (420ms); the log folds away after 0.9s.

states.title: error
states.description: "exit" morphs in and the code rolls in after it, in red. The log stays open, failing lines are tinted, and the first one scrolls into view.

states.title: cancelled
states.description: A stop mark and "stopped", with the log folded. Focus moves from Stop to the chevron.
